title: Jelexie Human Resources Information System
description: A comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) built with CakePHP, AngularJS, and MySQL, featuring daily time tracking, payroll automation, and secure QR code and fingerprint-based attendance logging. Designed with ease of use in mind, it simplifies HR operations for both employees and administrators—boosting accuracy, transparency, and productivity across the organization.

title: Bislig Electronic Barangay System
description: The Electronic Barangay System (EBS) is a community-focused Disaster Risk Reduction and Management (DRRM) platform built for barangay-level use. It empowers local officials to track disasters in real time, monitor evacuees, manage relief distribution, and coordinate emergency responses more efficiently—ensuring faster, more organized support when it matters most.

title: MakinaWorks
description: A one-page landing site built for Makina Works, a BPO CAD & Engineering services provider. Designed with Framer and developed in WordPress, it features a clean, responsive, and conversion-focused layout. Emphasizing clarity, brand professionalism, and calls to action, the site clearly presents technical services through a compelling digital narrative, enhancing online presence and boosting lead generation.
